{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(data.head())
print(data.info())
print(f"Number of rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of unique patients: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id with different sample_seq
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values('patient_id')
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(duplicate_patients[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'arm', 'responded']])

# Check arm assignment: is treatment arm non-randomised?
print(data['arm'].value_counts())
print(data['severity'].value_counts())
print(data.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts())"}
